prompts:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high-fidelity mobile UI concept board for the existing Socially Solana social investing app, Crew perspective. Landscape board containing THREE large flat mobile screens side by side, all complete, straight-on, readable, no device bezels, no perspective. Screen 1: Discover with Captains tab selected, Vaults sibling tab, search placeholder "Search @username", filter chips and real captain cards each with a wide coastal/photo banner plus separate overlapping circular portrait avatar, name, @username, 30D net return and AUM, view vaults action. Screen 2: same Discover with Vaults selected, search "Search vault name", phase and duration filters; independent vault banners and vault avatar images, vault name, Captain @username, Fundraising or Active phase, duration, participants and remaining capacity. Screen 3: Captain profile for Maya Chen @maya with own banner and portrait, public Crew-facing performance. Label "Paper trading" and "Sample data". Show 7D 30D 90D All selector, 30D net return +8.4%, max drawdown -4.2%, a legible line chart including zero and time axes, AUM 124,500 USDC, Crew 128, Active vaults 3, recorded coverage and "Net of assessed fees". CTA "Explore vaults". No private captain earnings, wallet balance, fake verification or APY guarantees. Distinguish portfolio performance from a viewer's personal return. The real app uses pale blue-grey #F5F7FB backgrounds, navy #182B43 text, white rounded surfaces, thin pale borders, coastal imagery, restrained frosted translucent navigation, Cormorant Garamond editorial serif headings and Inter labels, green #16805E gains and muted red losses. Bottom nav Home Discover Wallet Settings with Discover selected. Use tasteful real editorial portraits and independent coastal vault imagery. Keep all labels crisp and spacing generous. This image is a design proposal, not a screenshot of shipped UI.
Option 1: Closest to the current app: spacious full-width banner cards, pale glacier-blue segmented tabs, refined white layered cards. Emphasize calm product continuity.
